description.en: Original P.minchami-inspired fossil-form positive-cast study, not whole living organism or exact specimen replica. Primary2017 Figure4 latex moulds consulted as fossil-form positive relief rather than mislabelled direct body tissue. Nominal matrix70x80mm and ridge relief illustrative, not measured specimen. Affinity, anterior-posterior orientation, feeding, mobility and external nature of minor ridges uncertain; the two2017 papers offer differently qualified mobility inferences. No behavior/CFD result claimed.
